configuration.permissionMode.default: Standard behavior - prompts for dangerous operations

configuration.contextStrategy.descriptio: How conversation context is managed between turns

configuration.model.description: Claude model to use (empty for default). Examples: claude-sonnet-4-6, claude-opus-4-20250514
configuration.maxBudgetUsd.description: Maximum budget in USD per session (null for unlimited)
configuration.taskBudget.description: Token budget for the model to pace tool use (alpha). Set to null to disable.
configuration.maxThinkingTokens.descript: Thinking token budget for legacy models (Opus 4.5, Haiku 4.5). Applies only when thinking is not disabled. Null falls back to the default budget; use damocles.thinkingDisabled to turn thinking off.
configuration.thinkingDisabled.descripti: Disable thinking for all models. Suppresses adaptive thinking on 4.6+ models and extended thinking budget on legacy models (Opus 4.5, Haiku 4.5). Default: false.
configuration.effortByModel.description: Per-model reasoning effort overrides. Keyed by model id (e.g. "claude-opus-4-7"). Values: low, medium, high, xhigh (Opus 4.7 only), max.
configuration.betasEnabled.description: Enabled extended features (e.g., 1M context window for 4.6)
configuration.enableFileCheckpointing.de: Enable file checkpointing for undo/rewind functionality
configuration.pinnedHeaderHidden.descrip: Hide the pinned user-message header above the chat. A small floating chip lets you restore it.
configuration.maxIndexedFiles.descriptio: Maximum number of files to index for @ mention autocomplete
configuration.sandbox.description: Sandbox settings for command execution isolation
configuration.sandbox.enabled.descriptio: Enable sandbox mode for Bash commands
configuration.sandbox.allowUnsandboxedCo: Allow commands that cannot be sandboxed
configuration.sandbox.networkAllowLocalB: Allow binding to local ports in sandbox
configuration.providerProfiles.descripti: Provider profiles with environment variables for different API providers
configuration.providerProfiles.name.desc: Unique name for the provider profile
configuration.providerProfiles.env.descr: Environment variables for this provider (e.g., ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL, ANTHROPIC_AUTH_TOKEN)
configuration.activeProviderProfile.desc: Currently active provider profile name (null to disable)
configuration.autoCompact.description: Auto-compact settings for managing context window usage

configuration.autoCompact.warningThresho: Show warning indicator when context usage exceeds this percentage (default: 60%)
